notes.title: Kitty Survivors 1.0 Released!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After 7 months of Early Access Kitty Survivors 1.0 is now out!

I would like to thank everyone who supported the game in its Early Access version and helped me with feedback!

I hope you enjoy the new update!

[h3][b]New Content:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 New Characters: Tuna and Chubby
[*] 2 New Weapons: Shotgun and Fish
[*] 1 New Stage: Candyland (9 new enemies, 2 elites and 2 bosses).
[*] Crafted weapons now have perks on them based on the Grip material used.
[*] 3 New Power-ups: Decelerate (slows down enemies), Detonation (kills every enemy on screen), Big Gold Bag (100G)
[*] Pets now level up with the player, increasing their stats by 2.5% per level (Just inside a stage).
[*] Pet evolution system: when your pet reaches tier 5 you can evolve it. Its appearence and name will change, it will receive a stats boost and acquire a new ability.
[*] 14 New weapon materials added.
[*] 42 New Achievements added.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239624/09a5aedc3a097cf088e4a8e2a2678a3594af91d8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Puppergeist enemy doesn't become fully invisible anymore.
[*] Duration of Plains stage decreased from 20 to 15 minutes to match other stages.
[*] Perk evo combination is now displayed on Passive perks as well.
[*] More info added to the items on the Forge screen.
[*] Now the weapon chart displays more information regarding each weapon.
[*] In the Match Ended screen, you can now hover over materials and eggs obtained to check their info.
[*] Improved collision detection.
[*] Increased from 10 to 20 the weapon slots in the Armory.
[*] Improved pet movement and behaviour.
[*] You can now hover over eggs in the Incubator screen to see more info.
[*] You can now hover over your loot in the Chest screen to see more info.
[*] Added pet's element info in the pet panel at the Pet Zone.
[*] 'Level' nomenclature was replaced by 'Tier' for pets at the Pet Zone. Apples still work the same, but now instead of leveling up your pet, it increases its tier. Same thing.
[*] More info added to the Forge screen regarding item rarity and how their types influence weapon crafting.
[*] Added pet skill description in the pet panel at the Pet Zone.
[*] Perk evolution chart added to the Pause screen.
[/list]

[h3][b]Animations:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added chest opening animation.
[*] Added egg hatch animation.
[*] Added weapon craft animation.
[*] Added animation when obtaining an egg.
[*] Added pet evolution animation.
[*] Added animation when a pet increases its tier at the Pet Zone.
[/list]

[h3][b]Balancing Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Minigun: Decreased ammo clip and increased reload time.
[*] Dungeon Stage: Pink Slime and Flaming Head enemy now drop uncommon exp gem.
[*] Snowland: Snowman, Yeti and Santa Skeleton now drop uncommon exp gem.
[*] The exp gem from Tuna, the Wise evo perk now gives twice the exp of an uncommon gem.
[*] Kaboom ability (Devil): Decreased the chance from 50 to 12.5% of triggering, but it now deals same damage as your weapon, it used to be a fixed low amount.
[*] Camper Cat evo: damage increased from 450 to 1000.
[*] Backstab Skill (Little Ribs character): damage increased from 500 to 1000.
[*] Pets no longer get a boost on attack range and knockback when leveling / tiering up.
[*] In Heat perk: kitten spawn time decreased from 120 to 90 seconds.
[*] Increased gold drop amount.
[*] Changed weapon materials stats, rarity, drop location and price.
[*] Burn effect now deals 5% of the enemy's max health over 5 seconds.
[*] Increased exp obtained from every gem.
[/list]

[h3][b]Visual Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Skeletons from Plains stage now wear underwear.
[*] Enemy sprites updated.
[*] Vignette effect removed.
[*] Updated Plains stage colors.
[*] Vanilla character sprites updated.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Buttshot perk now increases damage correctly.
[*] Reload speed % is now displayed correctly in the Pause screen.
[*] Thundercock pet attack now selects targets correctly.
[*] Zeus perk now selects targets correctly.
[*] Yeti enemy no longer rushes towards the player after its rolling attack.
[/list]

By the way, it all started when my girlfriend moved in with me and her cat gave birth to 4 kittens. That's when I decided to make a game with cats and add all of them as characters. Peanut and Pancake are the parents:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239624/3c59b90c828de518b0cfbbb87bc8eaf1cddc3027.png[/img]

Remember to be kind to one another, we're all on this Earth together. Let's make it a fun ride!

Thank you all!

notes.title: EA 0.9.2 & SHMUP FEST!
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been a while!

[h3]We're participating in the Steam's SHMUP Fest, so if you don't have the game yet, [b]this a great time to get it with a discount![/b][/h3]

Now let's talk about what's new. This is a big patch and I think you will enjoy! [b]A lot of QOL work, bug fixes and reworks.[/b]

[b][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved sound effects and music. (New music for each stage and changed almost all sound effects)
[*] Now screens open in a queue. For example, if you level up at the same time as you loot a chest, the second screen will open after you close the first one.
[*] Auto fire is now the default option. Can still be toggled off on Settings / shortcut.
[*] Destructibles and power ups added to the Dungeon stage.
[*] You can now check how many enemies you defeated / are required to obtain new eggs.
[*] Status Effect rework: it now has a chance to trigger the effect directly when hitting an enemy. No need to combine two different elements.
[*] Craft rework: now there is a random range of damage and effect chance when crafting weapons. Even two weapons crafted with the same materials, can have different stats.
[*] Item rarity added. You can now see the rarity of your items by their slot color (brown = common, blue = rare, purple = epic)
[*] Elite monsters now have a health bar above their heads.
[*] Added some effects and changed a few UI elements / texts to juice things up.
[*] Changed the player's hit color to red.
[*] Added a "Give Feedback" button to the Main Menu and Pause screen
[/list]

[b][h3]Game Balance:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] The Wise perk buffed (xp gain)
[*] Magnetic Eyes perk buffed (pickup range)
[*] Catnip time decreased to 10 seconds. It was too OP against bosses.
[/list]

[b][h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented from obtaining eggs after completing the condition. If you already met the condition, just defeat one more enemy of said condition and it will give you the egg.
[*] Fixed a bug that displayed the text level incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that the character got slowed down for the rest of the run when stepping in consecutive holes (Snowland stage)
[*] Fixed a visual glitch when using the Tail Tornado perk.
[*] Fixed a visual glitch when enemies got defeated and had an effect icon above their heads.
[/list]

[b][h3]Status Effects & Elements rework:[/h3][/b]
Back then when I designed the elements, I thought it would be cool if they combined with each other and had elemental reactions. But it didn't work the way I intended. In this kind of game, too many things happen at the same time, making it difficult to combine attacks and elements strategically.
There were also some perks that would apply those effects directly, going against the first concept of elemental combinations. I decided to make it simpler, when an enemy gets hit, it has a chance of triggering the effect. By making it simpler, It will be easier to implement new effects and elements in the future, like poison and blood (lifesteal).

[b][h3]Craft & Item rarity:[/h3][/b]
Rarity affects the stats of an item. The higher the quality, the higher the damage and apply effect chance. In a future update, rarity will also affect the perks that can be randomized when creating weapons.

As always I'm open to feedback and suggestions, so drop them in the comments, [url=https://discord.com/invite/aEFjeRyRH3][b]Discord[/b][/url] or through the game by tapping the "Give Feedback" button!

Thank you for your time and I hope you have fun!
Angelo

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.05
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just a quick update.

[b][h3]0.9.05:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Now the Pet Zone displays the drop condition of every egg in the game.
[*] You can now see the portraits of every pet (silhouettes if still locked).
[*] The crafting achievements should be working now.
[*] Added a check to prevent bugs when trying to unlock achievements and Steam isn't connected yet. Hopefully it will fix other issues.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Next week I'll start working in the crafting system. I'll be reworking some things and adding perks to some crafting materials. I'm still trying to figure it all out, but it will probably work like this: the higher the crafting material tier, the higher the chance of a perk being added to the weapon when crafting it. There are a few things I'm not sure yet, if each material will have its own list of possible perks or if its the same list for all of them, just the crafting rate being influenced by the material. In higher tiers, I'm thinking about increasing the odds of adding perks and also the perk level it will be created. Higher materials would be able to craft perks up to level 5-6.

The perk added to your equipped weapon will probably be removed from the perk pool and you won't be able to level it further in the current run, but they won't take any slots, so it will be like an extra perk. This way, you will be encouraged to craft more frequently, to acquire weapons with better stats and perks. (If I take this route, I'll probably decrease the price of crafting, so players can do it more often).

What do you guys think? Do you have any suggestions regarding the crafting system and adding perks to weapons? Let me know in the comments!

Thank you and have a great weekend!
Angelo

notes.title: v0.9.025: Angel & Devil and Balancing
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you're all having an amazing week!

[h3]There're new features and balancing changes on today's update.[/h3]

First, let's start with the [b]Angel & Devil system[/b]. When you defeat an elite or boss, there's a chance to spawn an angel or a devil. Angels will always reward you with an ability and ask for nothing in return. They might increase your max health, heal you or boost one of your stats. The devil on the other hand will offer you better abilities, but will ask for some of your max health in return. It can give you an extra life, boost your stats or give you exclusive abilities. If you don't like what he's offering you, don't worry. You can always reject his offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239624/fcfcccce46bf609a9a70661bb47b7f83341b60f9.png[/img]

Now about the balancing changes. After watching gameplay videos and playing the game over and over again I decided to make a few changes.

There were some perks and weapons in the game that made it really hard to achieve a satisfying difficulty balance. Perks like [b]Multishot[/b], [b]Rubber Shot[/b] and [b]Not in the Head[/b] were too strong. In addition to that, if the player combined those with the [b]Boomerang[/b] weapon, the challenge of passing a stage was halved. I understand there will always be OP combinations and I actually like that, but there's a fine line between overpowered and not fun anymore. When you make it too strong, it affects every balance so far and with no challenge, the game gets boring really fast. So check below what has changed.

[h3][b]Balancing changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed "Sharp Weapon" Perk.
[*] Multishot perk added again.
[*] Decreased Multishot extra projectiles from 4 to 2.
[*] The perks "Not In The Head" and "Rubber Shot" are now Devil abilities.
[*] Piercing damage decreased from -25% to -33% by enemy hit.
[/list]

[h3][b]Boomerang rework:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Boomerang now shoots straight forward and after reaching a certain distance goes back to the player.
[*] Deals 70% damage when returning.
[*] Knockback decreased by 50%.
[/list]

I hope with these changes the game gets more enjoyable!

In case you guys have more things you'd like to share with me, about balancing or features in general, [url=https://discord.com/invite/aEFjeRyRH3][b]join our Discord[/b][/url] or post to the Community Hub!

Ps: In the upcoming weeks I'll finally be adding the Codex, a new stage with new bosses and enemies and more detailed descriptions of perks, weapons, stats modifiers, materials and so on. I'm planning on adding new perks and achievements as well.

Thank you and have a great day!
Angelo

notes.title: New stage, characters and active skills. Also new name!
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you are all doing great!

I know it's been a while since my last update. As I mentioned in a previous post, this one was going to be a bigger update so it would take a little longer.

[h3]First I'll talk about what's new and then I'll talk about the name change. So here is what's new:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added two new characters: Little Ribs and Peanut. I also named the default one to Vanilla. (They're all based on my cats in real life)
[*] Added a new stage: Dungeon.
[*] New enemies, elites and bosses.
[*] Now each character has a unique active skill. Dash skill is now considered a secondary skill and it's the default one for every character.
[*] Skills added: Scream, Backstab and Sushi Time!
[*] Added a trail effect for the dash skill.
[*] Added a new screen to select and unlock characters
[*] Added a message informing the player when it has reached the maximum number of weapons in Armory.
[*] Fixed the dance animation of the dancing skeletons.
[*] Removed classic mode difficulty levels for refactoring.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239624/fca738437f8eac49979a716deeda87793e427fac.png[/img]

You may also have noticed that I changed the name of the game from "Kittyverse of Madness" to "Kitty Survivors: Rogues of Catmere". There were a few reasons for that decision. First, the previous name didn't say much about the game, you would know it was somehow related to cats, but other than that it was hard to know that the game was a "survivors-like" game. The "-verse" part could also cause some confusion, because it's not related to multiverse as you see in movies. Second, with the new name I feel the game can now find and attract the right target audience. It will be better for the game longevity and to increase our community. 

From now on, I'll try to deliver weekly updates. I didn't like to take this long to deliver this update. It had to be done and was bigger than usual, but from now on I'll deliver smaller updates every week and will keep working on bigger ones and release them from time to time.

[h3]If you're not on Discord yet, I would like to invite you to [url=https://discord.gg/aEFjeRyRH3][b]join us[/b][/url] again. It's much faster to talk to you guys there and to collect feedback.[/h3]

Thank you for your time and have a great week!
Angelo

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap to 1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys, this is an overview to the full release of the game in a few months:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239624/9008d577264dff0ebf4d4348020c700acf502f4b.png[/img]

[b]Once the roadmap is complete, the game will leave Early Access and we will start the 1.0 version.[/b]

Note that some features might change along the way, it will all depend on the feedback you as players give me during the Early Access phase. There are also some minor features that I'll be adding to the game, which I felt it wasn't necessary to be part of the roadmap. Make sure to join my [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/aEFjeRyRH3]Discord server[/url][/b] so we can talk about features, feedback and other cool stuff.

[h3]Now, I'll talk a little about the [b]new features[/b] I'm planning on adding:[/h3]

[b]Codex:[/b] The codex will display everything you unlock in the game and will reward you for that. There will be rewards for defeating x number of enemies or defeating a particularly enemy x number of times. It will be similar to a bestiary in that matter, but will also contain information about perks, pets and so on. I'll add objectives to the codex, so let's say if you defeat 100 skeletons, you will be rewarded with gold or unlock an achievement. If you defeat 10000 skeleton there will be another reward... If you use a specific perk x number of times or deal x damage with a specific weapon.. by now you should have an idea of what I mean with the Codex.

[b]Perk evolution:[/b] Similar to other survivors games, you will be able to upgrade a perk beyond its maximum level. There will be synergies between perks, so you will have to equip one, to unlock the evolution of another.

[b]Pet evolution:[/b] When you level a pet to its maximum level, you will be able to evolve it to a stronger version. It will change its appearence and also unlock a new and unique ability.

[b]Angel & Devil:[/b] Sometimes an angel or a devil might appear in your runs. The angel will offer something to help you, without asking for nothing in return, may it be evolve one of your perks or heal one of your lives. The devil is a trickery one, it will have the most OP perks in the game, but will ask for a life in return. I'm still considering how they will appear in the game, at first I was planning to make them appear at random, when you open a chest, but now I'm thinking about giving you an objective that you need to complete to summon one of them.

I will be adding new characters and special abilities unique to each one of them. They will probably be similar to the dash ability, an active skill. I'm also planning new game modes: Quickplay, Endless and a [b]secret one[/b]. At some point I might rework the classic mode's difficulty, which is unlocked everytime you complete a match, and make it more challenging than just changing enemy attributes and spawn rate.

New maps will be added but I'm not sure when. First I need to make sure the one we have already is well balanced and fun.

I'm not sure if I'll be able to add Twitch integration and mod support before releasing the 1.0 version, but it's something that I want to add eventually.

I think I've covered the main points about the development road ahead, the announcement is getting too long, so I'm going to finish it now.

Thank you for supporting the development of Kittyverse, I believe that together we can make a great game! I hope you all have an amazing week!

If you have any questions, just comment on this post or send me a message on the Discord / Community Hub!

Thank you again,
Angelo

notes.title: Kittyverse is out NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys, Kittyverse is finally out in Early Access![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217740/Kittyverse_of_Madness/

[b]I'm preparing a roadmap that I will post in a couple weeks.[/b]

For now, my plan with the Early Access is to gather enough feedback to improve the game even further and add more features. So please share your thoughts in the Community Hub or join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/aEFjeRyRH3]Discord[/url]!

The current patch notes are:
[list]
[*] Added partial controller support (you can use it in a run, but not on menus)
[*] Removed the move speed penalty when shooting
[*] Added more items and a new weapon: Boomerang
[*] Now you can play the full ~20 minutes, with 3 bosses and 5 elite enemies in total
[*] You can choose between 3 starter pets and obtain more by playing
[*] You can give food to your pets to level them up and get them stronger
[*] Added permanent upgrades
[*] Overall balancing of weapons, perks and enemies stats
[*] Added New Game+ when completing the classic mode, up to level 10.
[*] Added Achievements, with many more to come
[*] Localization to brazillian portuguese
[/list]

What I plan on adding in the upcoming weeks:
[list]
[*] More polish to the game
[*] Destructible objects that drop gold, health and special items
[*] More characters
[*] Active skills
[*] Codex containing game stats such as enemies defeated, pets obtained, gold earned and so on
[*] New game modes
[*] Pet evolutions
[*] Perk evolutions
[*] And much more!
[/list]

So that's about it for now. I'll be working hard on the game as always and I hope you enjoy playing the game as much as I'm enjoying developing it. And if you do enjoy, please share it with your friends. Let's build a community together!

Thank you and I hope you have fun!
Angelo
